$comment: Written by hand. A run in plan mode: the model reads, then asks for an action of the Runtime and an action tool of the host, and is refused each, then saves a plan and answers. The host offers a read, an action that proposes, an action that saves, an action that remembers, a question and the plan tool.
request: Plan how to add a receipt rule to the expense pack. Do not change anything yet.

hostTools.name: read_policy
hostTools.description: Read one section of the expense policy.
hostTools.result: Section receipts: a claim above 50 USD is approved only when a receipt is attached.

hostTools.name: propose_pack
hostTools.description: Propose a pack for the person to review.

hostTools.name: remember_note
hostTools.description: Keep a note in the project's memory.

hostTools.name: propose_plan
hostTools.description: Save a plan for the person to review.
hostTools.result: Plan saved. The person must choose Start work.

steps: Test the rule against the saved cases

turns.say: I saved a three-step plan. Nothing is changed until you choose Start work.
